	<ResortReportHeadline>Saturday Special and Mum's The Word Raffle!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks like another cracker of a day on the way!&nbsp; The sky is clear, the wind is calm and it should stay very pleasant all day.&nbsp; The current temp is 3.5 degrees, and the forecast top is a balmy 6 degrees.&nbsp;</p><p>Although it's been a warm night, the snow has still had a decent freeze overnight, so will start the day off firm before the sunny aspects soften for fun spring-like turns as the day warms.&nbsp; The groomers feel like they have enough texture for good turns from the get-go, while off-piste will be best avoided until the sun has done its thing.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Road Runner is scheduled for First Tracks from 7.30am, and it'll be worth checking out Australia's best SBX athletes on their final races on the course this morning. Plus, keep riding into the dark at Night Skiing, 5-8pm under the Big D lights.&nbsp;</p><p>The <a href="https://www.mthotham.com.au/events/mums-the-word-rail-jam-2026" rel="nofollow">Mum's the Word</a>&nbsp;raffle kicks off at 5pm in Hotham Hotel, raising important funds for cancer. It'll be a mega auction with heaps of great prizes to be won, so don't forget to grab some raffle tickets today!</p><p>Slap on the screen and have a beaut day on the hill.</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>
